autonomous_design: The registered numerical time interval [0.25,0.75], bisection realization, analytic velocity_dt implementation, Agent-4 FD4 steps/sampling protocol, and this neighborhood-scope policy are repository designs.

pending_unknown: A final fixed-point correction, outer/global join, matched pressure, restricted forcing, and full-domain Navier-Stokes derivative/residual validation remain unavailable on this stack.

public_source_fact: The pinned Kokuno PA.10 reconstruction supplies the inner similarity-coordinate relations tau=q(1-eta^2), z=q^D eta, X=(x^2+y^2)/(2q) and the displayed Cartesian inner-center velocity formula.
